book.name: 1 Utasorhonika
book.title: Ubvur Uburhu uwu inggbaashia aka atsɛnge abi Utasorhonika

content: Itser Uburhu ru Utasorhonika
Umbi angwɛ̃mɛn nu anapumɛn, umbi ahwɛngmbi ugɛ iyiyepamɛn iki ĩba ru umbi isi igbangge abĩ.
Umɛn iki ihwamɛn ayetnum nu urhena ru Ufirhipi, ru nyaka umbi aka ahwɛng, bɔr iyiyike Unummɛn itsu umɛn ĩdzaa umbi Isarhe Iyiki Izenga ra asu uver ukerketakpɔ ukpu ikpikpɛ̃ɛ̃.
Ivangyɛ umɛn itsu umbi awe ru imangmang umɛn isi igbamɛn irhak use ida isisar use umɛn ibee ibvuta umbi.
Bɔr umɛn iwu abirabɛ Unum aka anyã umɛn imɛ̃ɛ̃mɛn idzowe Isarhe Iyiki Ize. Umɛn isi ĩbeemɛn irherhe abinkɛ anera aka abee bɔr abinkɛ Unum uwuku uvira amɛnmɛn aka abee.
Umbi ahwɛngmbi arherhamɛn asi iweke itonga angwĩ, use umɛn ikũ ubin ukpɔɔ itsire atsimɛn ri ibee uhwɛk, Unum unga awu idekamɛn.
Umɛn isi ĩbeemɛn anera akpoi umɛn, use umbi use abikase. Umɛn iwu abi itser Uyesu umɛn iwemɛn ri ijee iyiki ibee ubin ru umbi,
bɔr umɛn iwu ru nyaka awɛkaci ru umbi, ru nyaku uyi aki ikpɔm angwɛ̃nga.
Umɛn ibema umbi akarhãrhã, ngge itsu umɛn isi ĩdzaamɛn umbi Isarhe Iyiki Ize iyi Unum ukpekũ, bɔr umɛn igũibɛn idzowe urhɛmɛn, ubinkutsu umbi awe azeze ru umɛn.

Umbi angwɛ̃mɛn nu anapumɛn, idzidzɛrhe umbi ayitumbi ititɛ̃wãmɛn nu ayetnummɛn, umɛn itɔ̃ itser utsuu nu atenum isi igũmɛn azhe utsur umɛn iyɔmmɛn unera ru umbi ivangyɛ umɛn iki idzowe Isarhe Iyiki Ize ru umbi.
Umbi nggu Unum awu ideka, ra amɛn aka asar, nu irhirhika nu ida uvau umɛn iki iwe ru umbi abika adɔsa ri inggbaashia.
Ubinkutsu umbi ahwɛngmbi umɛn iwe nggu umbi ru nyaka atei aki iwe nggu awɛkacimbɔ.
Umɛn ifituwa ni iyika umbi ni itsu umbi asei ra amɛnkɛ Unum aka abee, unga aka ayisa umbi ri Iyɛrhanga nu ikpikpoi.

Umɛn isi inekukumɛn itar uwɛɛ ru Unum ra akɛrɛ ha, ubinkutsu, ivangyɛ umbi aka ayɛi Arherhu-Num umbi aka agũ ru umɛn, umbi abema ake asi iweke ru nyaka arherhe anera, bɔr ru nyaka ake aka awe. Awe Arherhu-Num aka atɔ̃ itser ru umbi aka awe ru imangmang.

Umbi angwɛ̃mɛn nu anapumɛn, umbi awe abika amesu kishoo ikikɔng abika adɔsu Unum ru Uyahudiya, umbɔ aka awe ru Ukiristo Uyesu. Umbi ahwa ayetnum ra anermbi ubina unying nggu abika adɔsa ha aka ahwa ra abok abi Uyahuda,
abika afɛre Uteijee Uyesu nu abika asɔm Arherhu-Num ikɛi na awayiwe umɛn idzek. Umbɔ adakuwe amɛn Unum na akpɛ̃mbɔ ubɛn unera

ri ititɛ̃wãmbɔ umbɔ akɛnmbɔ umɛn idzowe Isarhe Iyiki Ize ra atsen abi Uyahuda utsur umbɔ akpombɔ ififɔrh. Rimi hã ubɛn unum umbɔ aki itomu ugbiu arhimmbɔ akarhãrhã. Avɔm Unum aka acipuwake nu atsimbɔ.
Uburhu abee ibvui ayepaabi Utasorhonika
Bɔr umbi angwɛ̃mɛn nu anapumɛn, ivangyɛ umɛn iki idzipa ineke umbi ri ivanga ukunjiir, igigau ha iwu iyi iyor isi iwengge iyi amɛn, ngge itsu umɛn itsu asumɛn itɛ̃wã ibee ĩba inyã umbi.
Ubinkutsu umɛn ibee ĩba ru umbi, udzumunga awu umum Uburhu iki ibee ikɛi nu ikɛi, bɔr Ushaitan akɛna umɛn.
Asi iwea umbi awu ifosamɛn, nu igũibɛnmɛn nu ifur iyɛrheyɛ umɛn iki ikũ ifĩrhã ra asu Uteijee Uyesu unga aba abanga?
Idzidzɛrhe umbi awu ikpikpoimɛn nu igũibɛn.
